prompt:
The chart below shows the age structure of the population of one country in 2000 and 2025, and the graph shows the total population over the same period.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visuals.title: Population by age group, 2000 and 2025
visuals.alt: A bar chart comparing the percentage distribution of the population across six age groups for 2000 and 2025.

visuals.title: Total population, 2000-2025
visuals.alt: A line chart showing the total population rising from 8.2 million to 10.1 million between 2000 and 2025, then dipping slightly by 2025.

key_points: The population is ageing: the combined share of the three age groups above 45 rises from 32% to 46%
The share of the two youngest groups falls; the 0-14 group drops from 24% to 16%, the largest fall
The 75 and over group rises from 4% to 9%, more than doubling, but remains the smallest group in both years
The largest group changes: 0-14 in 2000, 30-44 in 2025
Total population rises from 8.2 million to 10.1 million, peaking in 2020, then dips slightly to 10.0 million by 2025

Growth slows: the first five years add 0.7 million, but 2015-2020 adds only 0.2 million; reading both visuals together shows that as the total population grows, the number of people in the older groups grows even faster than their share
common_mistakes: Describing only one of the two visuals — the task covers both.
Confusing percentage share with millions of people ('24 million children')
Not writing an overview that sums up the ageing pattern in one sentence
Skipping the 2020 peak and the small dip that follows
Speculating about causes or the future ('the birth rate fell because…')
